title: Vibration Trend Record
body:
Overview

This is Manon's original Signature counterpart for Vibration Trend Record inside the Maintenance Prognostics Signature Database, built as part of the Signature ecosystem rather than copied from any outside source. Analyzes equipment condition and estimates maintenance needs with uncertainty bounds. The Signature edition keeps the same discipline as the public edition: every entry states the task, shows the method in full, and carries a demo program that was genuinely executed at build time, so the result shown is a result that actually ran. Signature records are labeled as Signature originals wherever they appear, and they never present a design as an established fact. A design is called a design, a measured result is called a measured result, and the difference is kept visible in the record itself.

How it works

The method in each record reads condition signals over time, fits a trend, and projects when that trend reaches a maintenance threshold. Every projection carries uncertainty bounds, because a point estimate without bounds overstates what is known. A prognosis triggers inspection or maintenance planning; it never replaces inspection.

Worked detail

The worked detail for this Signature entry is concrete and reproducible. The accompanying demo program ran at build time and its output begins with: readings: [20.2, 21.7, 23.2, 24.7, 26.2, 27.7, 29.2, 30.7]. The complete program and its full output travel with this record, so any reader can re-run the code and confirm the result independently. The Signature version adapts the public method to Signature conventions: the same checks, the same honesty about limits, and the same requirement that a claim travel no further than its evidence. Where this entry describes a procedure, the steps are ordered and checkable; where it describes a model, the inputs, the calculation, and the uncertainty are all stated; where it describes a plan, the constraints are named first, because a plan that hides its constraints cannot be trusted when conditions change.

Use and ladder

A maintainer uses these records to schedule work before a failure instead of after it, and to explain, with bounds shown, why a given maintenance window was chosen. Teaching ladder: this record is ranked simple. Simple Signature records introduce one idea at a time, compounded records combine ideas into a working procedure, and most-complex records carry the full procedure with its edge cases and limits. Feasibility tier: established. Implementation status: established. When the status is designed, this record offers a design plus an executed demo; deployment is not claimed. The Signature edition stands alongside the public edition as Manon's own original counterpart, and both editions are linked from the database page so readers can compare them.
demo_code:
# Vibration Trend Record: project a condition trend to its maintenance threshold.
readings = [20.2, 21.7, 23.2, 24.7, 26.2, 27.7, 29.2, 30.7]
threshold = 45.0
slope = (readings[-1] - readings[0]) / (len(readings) - 1)
remaining = (threshold - readings[-1]) / slope if slope > 0 else float("inf")
print("readings:", readings)
print("trend per step:", round(slope, 2))
print("latest reading:", readings[-1], "threshold:", threshold)
print("estimated steps to threshold:", round(remaining, 1))
print("uncertainty bounds steps:", round(remaining * 0.8, 1), "to", round(remaining * 1.25, 1))
